english.note: Use this for the balanced matching of colours, design features, or other non-musical elements.

examples.english: The colours in this furniture set are in pleasing harmony.
examples.traditional: 呢套家俬嘅顏色好協調。

english.note: Use this when the emphasis is on getting several people, teams, or work areas to function together.

examples.english: The choreography behind getting several teams to work together isn’t easy.
examples.traditional: 幾隊人一齊做嘢，背後嘅協調真係唔容易。
